answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by requiring five established non-kin witnesses for every payout and slashing their locked stake if they attest duplicates. A new key starts with zero weight, like a seed in a garden, and only gains weight after weeks of unique work that strangers verify. When a gale of fresh accounts appears at once, they can only witness each other, so their closed cluster is discounted to near zero. Each honest pearl of verified history is rare and costly to fake, so multiplying identities multiplies cost without multiplying rewards.
